principle: Gospel identity, audience trust, safeguarding and editorial independence come before commercial participation.

rules.title: Gospel-first identity
rules.summary: Content and partnerships must fit the Gospel and Christian-faith positioning of YHVH GOSPEL TV.

rules.title: Editorial independence
rules.summary: No payment, donation, sponsorship or relationship buys airtime, favourable treatment, ministry endorsement or editorial approval.

rules.title: Rights and permissions
rules.summary: Contributors must control or properly license the music, footage, performances, images, trademarks and other third-party material they submit.

rules.title: Creator ownership by default
rules.summary: Contributors retain ownership unless a separate written acquisition agreement says otherwise. Broadcast, promotional, translation and distribution rights must be expressly licensed.

rules.title: Truthful claims and fundraising
rules.summary: Fraudulent testimony, fake fundraising stories, deceptive investment schemes, undisclosed beneficiary arrangements and manipulative financial pressure are prohibited.

rules.title: Safety and dignity
rules.summary: No pornography, sexual exploitation, hate speech, incitement, harassment, dehumanising content or exploitation of vulnerable people.

rules.title: Child safeguarding
rules.summary: Content involving minors requires appropriate consent, safeguarding and careful handling of personal information and location details.

rules.title: Health and deliverance claims
rules.summary: Faith testimony is welcome, but medical or mental-health claims may not be presented as guaranteed cures or instructions to abandon appropriate professional care.

rules.title: Political separation
rules.summary: Social and civic discussion may occur, but the Gospel network is not a party campaign platform. Political advertising or campaigning requires separate policy and legal review.

rules.title: Commercial suitability
rules.summary: Sponsors and advertisers are verified and must fit a Gospel/family environment. Commercial messages are clearly distinguished from editorial programming.

rules.title: Broadcast standards
rules.summary: YHVH may request technical, duration, accessibility, graphics or compliance changes while preserving the contributor's meaning.

rules.title: Submission is review, not approval
rules.summary: YHVH may approve, request changes, schedule later, decline or remove material subject to rights, quality, safety, accuracy, brand and contractual requirements.

rules.title: Territories and languages
rules.summary: Contributors must identify the territories and language rights they control. YHVH does not assume worldwide rights that a contributor does not possess.

rules.title: Translation integrity
rules.summary: Dubbing, subtitles and localisation must preserve Scripture, testimony, attribution and the speaker's core meaning.

rules.title: Written revenue arrangements
rules.summary: Revenue shares, fees, taxes, reporting, refunds and payment cycles are agreed in writing before monetisation.

rules.title: Verification before payments
rules.summary: Paid partners and suppliers may be required to complete identity/entity and bank-detail verification, including secondary verification for banking changes.

rules.title: Conflicts of interest
rules.summary: Material commercial, family or decision-making conflicts relevant to a programme, supplier or sponsor must be disclosed.

rules.title: Respect across denominations and cultures
rules.summary: Robust discussion is permitted; personal attacks, harassment or degradation based on denomination, ethnicity, nationality or culture are not.

rules.title: Complaints and takedowns
rules.summary: Rights, privacy, safeguarding, factual or contractual complaints may trigger temporary suspension while reviewed.

rules.title: Final broadcast decision
rules.summary: YHVH retains final authority over scheduling, branding, editorial standards, distribution and removal, subject to definitive contracts and applicable law.

legal_note: This Charter is an operational participation policy and does not replace a definitive partner, licence, sponsorship, distribution or production agreement where one is required.
